item.description:

item.title: Researchers discover rare star system that emits radio signals every 8 minutes
item.description:
📝 Scientists at the Curtin University node of the International Centre for Radio Astronomy Research (ICRAR) have linked mysterious radio pulses to an unusual pairing of stars — a dead star that spins every eight minutes and a star similar to our own Sun. It is the first time radio pulses have been detected from a white dwarf orbiting a Sun-like star. While several previously discovered LPT systems contain a white dwarf and another star, it has remained unclear which of the two stars was generating the radio pulses.
🔗 Read more: https://www.curtin.edu.au/news/media-release/researchers-discover-rare-star-system-that-emits-radio-signals-every-eight-minutes/

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after reports of second affair deepened scandal
item.description:
📝 Rachel ClunBusiness reporter, in New York Nvidia shares opened down more than 13%, wiping more than half a trillion dollars off the firm’s share market value following news that Jensen Huang had resigned as chief executive. Nvidia shares had been plummeting before the market’s opening bell after news broke on Wednesday evening that Huang had allegedly had an affair with a woman within the company. The firm, which is key to the artificial intelligence industry, will report its latest financial results next Tuesday.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/c6zjry11v8w1t
